about: The one curated source for where the Tear program stands. docs/POSITION.md is rendered from this file by `pnpm position:render`, and `pnpm check:docs` fails when the rendered file is stale or was edited by hand. Each area records its state in a few words, what is true now, the next step, what only the owner can do, and evidence: repository paths that exist, or links to pull requests. Change this file in the same pull request that changes an area's state, update `curated` when you review the whole file, and re-render.

production.note: Deployed after the owner played it and said the build is good. The previous release was the 2026-08-30 build 9e7d6a70.

areas.name: Release readiness
areas.summary: Pull request 85 merged the release-readiness line on 2026-11-13 (developer surfaces gated out of release builds, menu UI rebuilt, startup payload 4.13 MB to 2.10 MB, offline cache 14.77 MB to 6.74 MB, new code-budget, determinism and architecture gates). Follow-ups 86, 87 and 89 to 92 merged the same day (runtime split, one world constructor, Prettier). The phase table in the plan still shows the pre-merge states.

areas.name: Verdant Sanctum visuals
areas.summary: Verdant has a painted background drawn from a scene package, with platforms still drawn by the game from collision geometry. The same format, command and checks work for any biome; a Pale Traverse placeholder fixture proves it. Boss warnings and strikes on Verdant are drawn as roots and thorns rising from the floor, from a table on the stage's presentation definition that any biome can supply. The background does not move yet.
areas.next: Living motion (water, light, foliage) as package data, in its own pull request.
areas.owner_action: Judge the look: the owner's taste decides visual work. A sharper, wider source painting that meets the brief in docs/BACKGROUND_WORKFLOW.md would remove most of the readability shading.

areas.name: Repository structure and workflow
areas.summary: Porting the structure patterns recommended by the comparison with the owner's OFFSLCT project. Merged: this generated position file, decisions and pitfalls, the repository map with size caps, the pull request and task card templates, the tool catalogue with pnpm who, change-impact completeness and release compatibility fixtures. Open: the owner guard hooks and merge helper moving into scripts/governance/.
areas.next: After the hooks pull request merges, run pnpm setup:hooks in the canonical checkout on main (scripts/governance/README.md).

areas.name: Playtest tool
areas.state: Stage 1 in part: pnpm playtest bosses prints a table per boss fight and phase, from Phase I or a chosen phase
areas.summary: One command, pnpm playtest, that plays the game headless with scripted players on fixed seeds and reports clear rates, time to kill, damage taken and differences between builds. It is built from the working parts of TearBench and the scripted player and replaces both names. Verified on 2026-11-16: the scripted player runs headless at 13 to 15 times real time and the same seed reproduces exactly.
areas.next: Rest of stage 1: a player that cuts Grafts, the still, walker and no-dodge players, and the sweep over weapons and seeds.
